{{short description|Danish mathematician (1943–2015)}}
'''Hans Bruun Nielsen''' (1943 – 2015) was a Danish [[mathematician]] and Associate Professor of [[Technical University of Denmark]] specializing in [[Numerical analysis]] and the application of [[numerical methods]].

== Book ==

* Eldén, Wittmeyer-Koch, '''Nielsen''' ''Introduction to Numerical Computation - analysis and MATLAB illustrations'', 2004 [[Studentlitteratur]] ([http://www.studentlitteratur.se/o.o.i.s/103] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050409163053/http://www.studentlitteratur.se/o.o.i.s/103 |date=2005-04-09 }}), {{ISBN|91-44-03727-9}}
** [http://www.studentlitteratur.se/o.o.i.s/?id=2362&artnr=31885-01&what=toc&csid=102 The book's Contents page] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060307151724/http://www.studentlitteratur.se/o.o.i.s/?id=2362&artnr=31885-01&what=toc&csid=102 |date=2006-03-07 }}
** [https://web.archive.org/web/20040826151543/http://www.imm.dtu.dk/~hbn/IntroNumComp/formulas.pdf Formulae from the book] (E.g. order of [[Cholesky decomposition]] computations, maximum error in [[Chebyshev nodes#Approximation|Chebyshev interpolation]], and maximum [[Numerical stability|stable step length]] using [[Runge-Kutta]].)

* [http://www2.imm.dtu.dk/projects/immoptibox/ immoptibox]: matlab toolbox for optimization and data fitting
